_notice: SYNTHETIC DATA — fictional agents for the WAKALA prototype. No real entity, officer or system is represented.

agents.name: Residency Agent
agents.description: Reads an applicant's residency status, prepares renewal applications and may request narrowly scoped verification tasks from other agents.
restrictions: May act only for the citizen named in its active mandate.
Cannot initiate payments directly; may only request them from the Payment Agent.
Cannot grant another agent more authority than it holds.

agents.name: Insurance Agent
agents.description: Verifies whether the applicant holds valid health insurance cover for the renewal request it was delegated.
restrictions: Cannot access citizen records unrelated to the delegated request.

agents.name: Payment Agent
agents.description: Requests payment of an authorized renewal fee to the official (fictional) government payment destination.
restrictions: May only pay to the official fictional destination SYNTH-GOV-TREASURY-0001.
Cannot initiate arbitrary transfers or exceed the mandated fee amount.
